verdict.rationale: Recruitee supports the pool side of a talent CRM. Offers can be created as a 'talent pool' (docs-29, docs-42), and the support site describes building your own database of potential candidates and searching it with Boolean filters (docs-16, docs-17). Outreach is evidenced only as one-off emailing of candidates with reusable templates (docs-18, docs-19); nothing shows automated multi-step sequences, open/click tracking, or nurture campaigns for future roles. Missing for 10: personalized automated email sequences, email engagement tracking, nurture campaign functionality, in-depth docs or independent corroboration of the talent pool/CRM workflow.
